name: filling-machine-hmi
description: Electron HMI for the filling machine — Modbus TCP control of start/stop, quantity, filling direction, stock refill, status/RFID readback, OEE dashboard, and a rule-based (no training required) red/blue ball fill detector that pulses M69 for 1s on a rejected/empty capture. The fill detector runs as a compiled standalone exe (scripts/dist/analyze_box.exe, built with PyInstaller — see scripts/BUILD_STANDALONE_EXE.md) with no Python install required on the target machine; falls back to spawning system Python only if that exe is missing.
author: Suyash Gautam
